rationale: The assistant correctly asked for a by-hand drum check first, then diagnosed a snapped belt from the easy spin and the black strip. It handled the worn sticker well by suggesting the code on the old belt be read and did not claim an exact part number. Minor weaknesses: the first reply gave prices in dollars, safety warnings about capacitor and sharp edges were light (unplugging was stated), and it assumed the TVHM80 series from only the TVHM8 prefix.
